items.title: Florida Qiskit Hackathon: Quantum Horizons, Oct 17-18
items.summary: QDC is hosting FAU's IBM Qiskit Fall Fest hackathon. Register on DeepStation, set up your IBM Quantum account, and take our team-matching quiz. Every team pairs a Business and an Engineering student. No quantum experience needed.

items.title: Qiskit Workshop & Social, Tue Oct 6, 4-6 PM
items.summary: A beginner-friendly, hands-on intro to Qiskit at the Gruber AI Sandbox (LY-103) in Wimberly Library. Learn the basics, try some quantum coding, and meet potential hackathon teammates. Just bring a laptop.

items.title: State report names Florida an emerging quantum leader, citing FAU
items.summary: A new FloridaCommerce-commissioned assessment of Florida's quantum ecosystem highlights defense and real-world deployment as the state's big opportunities, pointing to FAU's $20 million D-Wave Advantage2 system and D-Wave's move to Boca Raton.

items.title: Robert Loredo publishes a playbook for the quantum era
items.summary: The executive director of FAU's Center for Quantum Technologies released Quantum Readiness for Leaders (Packt), a practical guide to building quantum strategies, teams, partnerships, and post-quantum security.

items.title: Quantum machine learning to predict heart disease
items.summary: An FAU engineering team built a quantum machine-learning framework that reached over 90% accuracy predicting heart disease from clinical data on 918 patients, a real-world glimpse of what quantum-assisted AI can do.

items.title: FAU launches a quantum computing course for business
items.summary: FAU's College of Business introduced an Executive Education certificate, Quantum Computing: Business and Sourcing Strategy, bringing quantum out of the lab and into managerial and procurement decisions.

items.title: A director for the Center for Quantum Technologies
items.summary: Robert Loredo was named executive director of FAU's Center for Quantum Technologies, leading the university's quantum strategy, research, and workforce education.

items.title: D-Wave moves its headquarters to Boca Raton
items.summary: D-Wave is relocating its corporate headquarters and a major U.S. R&D facility to Boca Raton, bringing one of the world's leading quantum computing companies to FAU's home city.

items.title: Florida's first onsite quantum computer
items.summary: FAU signed a $20 million agreement for a D-Wave Advantage2 system, making it the first university in Florida to host public, onsite quantum hardware, right here in Boca Raton.

items.title: NIST picks an FAU-co-developed encryption standard
items.summary: NIST selected HQC, an algorithm co-developed by FAU's Edoardo Persichetti, as a new post-quantum encryption standard, part of the work to keep data secure against future quantum computers.

items.title: FAU Receives NIST Grant to Build Quantum Cybersecurity Workforce
items.summary: FAU has received a $200,000 NIST award to strengthen the quantum cybersecurity workforce across South Florida and the Treasure Coast through hands-on training, curriculum development and career pathways.

evergreen.title: The Quantum Computing Initiative
evergreen.summary: The College of Engineering's Quantum Computing Initiative anchors FAU's program, partnering with IBM Quantum on research across quantum computing, security, and communications.

evergreen.title: A quantum ecosystem spanning every college
evergreen.summary: FAU's Schmidt College of Science lists faculty across seven departments, from physics and math to biology and urban planning, working on quantum. It's interdisciplinary, which is exactly the point of this club.
